children: FB Financial raised $125 million through the issuance of 6.625% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036, enhancing capital for general corporate purposes and to support FirstBank’s growth. The notes carry a fixed rate until Oct. 1, 2031, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 205 bps, and are callable at par from Oct. 1, 2031, subject to regulatory approval. The issuance was completed under a new subordinated indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee and marketed pursuant to an underwriting agreement with Keefe, Bruyette & Woods. Management expects the financing to strengthen flexibility and fund ongoing expansion.
